queue_properties: atomic concurrent claims and expiring leases
append-only run, job, and attempt journal
stable result IDs and idempotent enqueue
unknown worker-loss attempts retained before retry
dependency failures skip downstream jobs while cleanup remains runnable
frozen snapshot, artifact-lock, and profile-lock hashes pinned in each run manifest

catalog.preflight: Each run checks raw source lengths and SHA-256, derived snapshot identity, provenance catalog/changes hashes, entry ID uniqueness and denominator, and artifact/profile lock cross-links. Full raw-to-normalized verification remains in the S2-01 snapshot acceptance evidence.

attempt artifact references remain attached to historical attempts
idempotent dispatch and conflicting manifest rejection
dependency ordering and cleanup after failure
